description: Experiment A, HADOOP half (baseline at minimum EMR capacity). Runs the Hadoop jobs of the bounded pipeline (J01 to J09) on DBLP dblp-2026-11-01 with dblp.dtd as a NEW run at the session 2 build commit, into its own output root curated/hadoop-p15/ATTEMPT_ID (G-20: the Hadoop record lists every run under its root), with the EMR managed-scaling maximum set to 2 core units (= the minimum 2, so capacity is flat by construction). Records input and output records (ScholarChain job counters), task counts (input splits from the step logs), duration (step and execution times), failures, estimated cost (instance lifecycle) and the EMR capacity series. Settings that differ from Phase 14: managed-scaling maximum 2 (Phase 14: 4). Compared only with Phase 14 D6 attempt 4 (attempt 20261119T005309Z-f159535e498a-2fcc, J09 run=ce46078e05b80d2d5e119939b7d04306, maximum 4) as an earlier reference that did not run under a manifest; never summed with the Spark half.
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml)

resourceLimits.emrUnitType: Instances (core nodes; the primary node is outside the limits)
resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/environments/course/variables.tf (emr_managed_scaling_min_units 2, emr_managed_scaling_max_units 4); execution-input field cluster.managedScalingMaxUnits resolved and bounded in state ReadInput (infra/terraform/modules/workflow/sfn.tf); infra/terraform/modules/workflow/variables.tf (pipeline_timeout_seconds 14400); infra/terraform/modules/emr/variables.tf (idle_timeout_seconds)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. First live use of the execution-input field cluster.managedScalingMaxUnits (D7a, attended). COST (estimate): expected about $1.20 = about 1.6 h (Phase 14 D6 attempt 4 took 63 min while its core nodes rose to 4 for about half the time, so at 2 core nodes about 1.5 h plus cluster start; estimate) x 3 m5.xlarge instances x $0.24 per instance-hour (COSTS.md EMR row, estimate); costBoundUsd 2.5 is about twice that; upper bound from the remote limits (state machine 14,400 s + idle end 900 s at 3 instances) about $3.10 (estimate). DURATION: pipeline --wait-timeout 14,700 s (past the state machine's own 14,400 s); maxDurationSeconds 18,600 = 14,700 + cluster end wait 900 + step-log waits up to 2,400 + 600 margin. METRICS: every EMR query above seen in account (aws-api list-metrics on the Phase 14 cluster j-07168191925RA7C2EGJU, 6b); TotalUnitsRequested/TotalUnitsRunning/CoreUnits* dropped (not published for these instance-group clusters; the managed-scaling series are the *Nodes* ones); AWS/States ExecutionsStarted, ExecutionsSucceeded, ExecutionsFailed, ExecutionsTimedOut, ExecutionTime seen in account with dimension StateMachineArn (they count every execution of the state machine in the window, so an overlapping run is included). LIMITATIONS known in advance: capacity is flat by construction (maximum = minimum = 2), so A shows no scaling; Hadoop map task counts are input splits from the step logs and reduce counts and shuffle are missing (the driver runs waitForCompletion(false), so MapReduce counters are not logged and _job.json holds only ScholarChain counters); released capacity at cluster termination is a lifecycle record, not a scale-in; the Phase 14 reference ran at maximum 4 and at another build commit.
